description: Builds "a plan we can return to": a term-by-term roadmap from today to the last decision date, for a child in grade 5 to 12. Covers selective middle-to-high-school admissions (TJHSST, magnet and boarding schools) as well as college. Give the current grade, up to six school names, and optionally interests (for example "biology research" or "math competitions") and the current school. For each school it lists when the application opens, the deadline, tests and interviews, decisions and the reply date, using published dates; when a school has not published its next cycle yet, the date is projected from last cycle and labeled "dates not yet published; last cycle was ...". It also adds competitions with real dates (AMC 8/10/12, AIME, MATHCOUNTS and others that match the interests), summer and research programs, testing guidance labeled typical timing, and course checkpoints such as the TJ Algebra 1 rule. Every item has a source, an as-of date and a link. The reply includes a calendar subscribe link (and a webcal:// version) that rebuilds the roadmap each time the calendar refreshes. It plans dates only and never states a chance of admission.

currentSchool.description: Optional name of the child's current school

grade.description: The child's current grade (5 to 12). In summer, use the grade just finished.

interests.description: Optional interests, e.g. "biology research, math competitions"

targets.description: Up to six high schools and/or colleges, e.g. ["TJ", "Exeter", "UVA"]. Leave out to see competitions, programs and testing guidance only.

name: admissions_roadmap
title: Semester-by-semester roadmap
